newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Cherry unit plans keyboard plant.
newsitem.headline: Czech Cherry unit plans keyboard plant.

text.p: The Czech unit of U.S.-based computer electronics component maker Cherry Corp said on Monday it would add a new Czech factory to make microswitches and computer keyboards.

Borek Lebl, an official of the subsidiary in the northwest town of Klaterec nad Ohri, said the new factory would join operations making the same products at factories in the nearby town of Ostrov and in Klasterec.
The new factory, to be built this year, would employ in its initial stage about 500 people, he said.
"The (new) stand-alone factory will have the possibility of further assembly halls which could employ another 200 or 300 people," Lebl told Reuters.
He declined to disclose financial details of the investment.
Cherry Czech Republic is a fully-owned subsidiary of Cherry Microschalter GmbH, fully-owned by U.S. Cherry Corp.
